originalFamilyScopeSummary: [Extension] Use a fresh Perps balance in MM Pay withdrawal confirmation
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: fix(perps): use a fresh Perps balance in MM Pay withdrawal confirmation
notes: The branch replaces the synchronous PerpsStreamManager cache peek with a coalesced fresh perpsGetAccountState read, gated on the confirmation being a perpsWithdraw, and gives the degraded read its own alert key/copy instead of folding it into the insufficient-balance bucket. Re-validated on this run against branch + origin/main after a rebase: the inherited recipe passes 22/22 nodes, and its live probe still reproduces the ticket's condition on the merged state (streamed cache empty at $0 while the fresh read returns $756.36, so a valid $378 withdrawal is blocked from the streamed cache and allowed from the fresh read). Changed-file ESLint/Prettier/Jest gate passes (37/37 across the 3 changed suites); PR-diff files are at 100% new-line coverage and SonarQube reports 98.4% on new code. This run added no code: the only actionable finding was the merge conflict with main, resolved by rebasing (mergeable went false/dirty -> true). One deliberate carve-out remains, filed as TAT-3661 rather than dropped: the 'Available balance' readout and the Max/percentage presets on the same confirmation still read the streamed subscription, so they can briefly disagree with the alert. That is display plumbing outside TAT-3632's blocking-decision scope, so the family's stated scope is fully addressed.
